jobs.description:
Audio Artist - EA Sports NHL - 216383 - Electronic Arts Skip to content Electronic Arts Open Roles About EA EA Careers EA News Login English - US Chinese English - US Finnish Français Italian Korean Malay Polish Romanian Spanish Swedish Audio Artist - EA Sports NHL Home ... Open Roles Role Detail General Information Locations : Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada Role ID 216383 Worker Type Temporary Employee Studio/Department EA Studios - SPORTS Work Model Hybrid Description & Requirements Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen. Audio Artist II – Speech Production EA SPORTS™ NHL Who We Are EA SPORTS is one of the most iconic brands in entertainment – connecting hundreds of millions around the world to the sports they love through a portfolio of industry-leading video games. EA SPORTS NHL has revolutionised sports gaming for millions of players worldwide. We've pioneered award-winning creative technology and experiences to connect players to the speed, skill, and heart of the NHL. Role Overview We are looking for an Audio Artist II to join the EA SPORTS NHL Audio team. The primary focus of this role is mastering, organising, and delivering high-quality recorded speech for commentary, voice-over, and other in-game experiences. You will also support speech-production workflows using AI tools that help the team maintain content at scale. Reporting to the Audio Lead, you will work independently within a defined area, applying editorial judgement and technical discipline to ensure assets meet creative, pipeline, and in-game quality standards. The Challenge Ahead Your challenge will be to turn recorded and generated source material into game-ready assets while maintaining accuracy across naming, metadata, versioning, and delivery. You will review content critically and work with speech leads, audio leadership, production, and technical partners to resolve issues. You will contribute ideas within your area, help improve established workflows, estimate your work with guidance, and communicate status, dependencies, and risks early. Who You Are You are an audio professional with dialogue-editing and mastering skills. You are comfortable working through high volumes of content without losing consistency, and you understand how editorial choices affect clarity, authenticity, and the player experience. You evaluate and integrate new tools through active testing and structured analysis. You will review audio outputs to identify artifacts and inconsistencies, correct manageable issues through direct editing, and escalate complex problems to the speech team. You will maintain structured asset workflows, integrate team reviews into your daily process, and implement solutions to increase our audio processing pipeline's reliability. Responsibilities Master, clean, and quality-check commentary, dialogue, and other speech assets. Use approved speech-generation and processing tools to create or adapt content, then evaluate and prepare outputs to team standards. Identify issues involving noise, level, dynamics, spectral balance, timing, pronunciation, continuity, or processing artifacts. Maintain accurate naming, metadata, versioning, source files, and delivery structures. Prepare, import, and validate speech assets in game-audio tools, databases, and established pipelines. Track assigned work, provide estimates with lead support, and communicate priorities, dependencies, and schedule risks. Participate in troubleshooting and recommend practical improvements to tools and workflows. Document processes and share knowledge. Requirements Professional experience editing and mastering dialogue, commentary, VO, ADR, broadcast, or comparable speech content. Advanced proficiency with Pro Tools or another professional DAW, including dialogue cleanup, EQ, dynamics, noise reduction, loudness control, and batch workflows. Demonstrated experience evaluating audio to identify subtle quality, consistency, and processing errors. 3+ years of experience managing assets against technical specifications, naming conventions, metadata, and version-control requirements. Experience with game-audio authoring tools, databases, or content pipelines. You will document technical workflows, track project milestones, and coordinate asset deliveries across multiple technical and creative departments. Experience with modern speech-production, voice-processing, automation, or scripting workflows is an asset. Pay Transparency - North America COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS The ranges listed below are what EA in good faith expects to pay applicants for this role in these locations at the time of this posting. If you reside in a different location, a recruiter will advise on the applicable range and benefits. Pay offered will be determined based on a number of relevant business and candidate factors (e.g. education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, or business needs). PAY RANGES * British Columbia (depending on location e.g. Vancouver vs. Victoria) *$67,000 - $92,700 CAD Pay is just one part of the overall compensation at EA. In Canada, we offer a package of benefits including vacation (3 weeks per year to start), 10 days per year of sick time, and extended health/dental/vision coverage and basic life insurance. About Electronic Arts We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth. We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do. Electronic Arts is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will also consider employment qualified applicants with criminal records in accordance with applicable law. jobs.title: Concepteur audio technique / Technical Audio Designer
jobs.description: En tant que concepteur audio technique, vous vous situez à l’intersection du design sonore et de l’ingénierie, transformant les éléments audio en systèmes en jeu performants et peaufinés. En collaboration avec les concepteurs sonores, les ingénieurs et les concepteurs techniques, vous intégrerez l’audio dans Unreal Engine et Wwise, concevrez des outils et optimiserez les performances. Il s’agit d’un rôle pratique destiné à une personne souhaitant évoluer à la jonction de la création et de la technique. Contrat de 12 mois Responsabilités: Intégrer les éléments audio dans Unreal Engine à l’aide du moteur sonore Wwise, de l’élément source jusqu’au système jouable. Concevoir et maintenir des systèmes audio basés sur les Blueprints. Développer et améliorer des outils permettant d’accélérer le flux de travail des concepteurs sonores. Profiler et optimiser l’audio en termes de CPU, mémoire, nombre de voix et flux (streaming) à l’aide du Wwise Profiler et d’Unreal Audio Insights. Respecter les directives d’organisation des données et de mixage de Wwise afin de garantir la cohérence du contenu et sa capacité à passer à l’échelle. Diagnostiquer et résoudre les problèmes audio en collaboration avec l’équipe de développement. Rédiger et maintenir la documentation technique des fonctionnalités, outils et flux de travail audio. Communiquer clairement les progrès et les contraintes techniques aux collaborateurs non techniques. Exigences: 3 ans ou plus d’expérience en audio technique, incluant un cycle de production complet jusqu’au lancement du jeu. Compétences démontrables en intégration audio avec Unreal Engine et Wwise. Solide maîtrise des Blueprints Unreal pour l’intégration audio. Maîtrise de Wwise. Connaissance pratique d’une station de travail audio numérique (DAW) telle que Reaper ou Pro Tools. Fortes capacités de résolution de problèmes et souci du détail. Capacité à apprendre rapidement de nouvelles technologies, outils et concepts. Bonnes aptitudes en communication et travail d’équipe, incluant la capacité d’expliquer des contraintes techniques à des collaborateurs non techniques. Intérêt réel pour l’audio technique appliqué au jeu vidéo, couplé à une bonne oreille. Atouts: Bonne compréhension de Wwise Spatial Audio. Connaissance pratique de l’API Wwise Authoring (WAAPI). Compétences en programmation d’scripts en Python ou C#. Connaissance de base du C++ et de son rôle dans Unreal Engine. Technical Audio Designer As a Technical Audio Designer, you sit between sound design and engineering, turning audio assets into polished, performant in-game systems. Working with audio designers, engineers, and technical designers, you will implement audio in Unreal Engine and Wwise, build tooling, and optimize for performance. This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to grow at the intersection of creative and technical craft. 12-month contract Responsibilities: Integrate audio assets into Unreal Engine using the Wwise sound engine, from source asset to playable system. Build and maintain Blueprint-based audio systems. Develop and improve tools that speed up the audio designers' workflow. Profile and optimize audio for CPU, memory, voice count, and streaming using the Wwise Profiler and Unreal Audio Insights. Uphold Wwise data organization and mixing guidelines so content stays consistent and scales across the project. Troubleshoot and resolve audio issues in collaboration with the development team. Write and maintain technical documentation for audio features, tools, and workflows. Communicate progress and technical constraints clearly to non-technical collaborators. Required: 3+ years of technical audio experience, including one full production cycle through ship. Demonstrable audio implementation skills with Unreal Engine and Wwise. Strong command of Unreal Blueprints for audio implementation. Proficient with Wwise. Working knowledge of a DAW such as Reaper or Pro Tools. Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. Ability to quickly learn new technology, tools, and concepts. Good communication and teamwork abilities, including explaining technical constraints to non-technical collaborators. Genuine interest in technical audio for games, with a good ear. Nice to have: Good understanding of Wwise Spatial Audio. Working knowledge of the Wwise Authoring API (WAAPI). Scripting abilities in Python or C#. Surface level understanding of C++ and its role in Unreal Engine. Justification des exigences linguistiques NetEase s'engage à favoriser un environnement de travail francophone pour ses employés au Québec. Tous les efforts ont été faits pour éviter d'exiger une langue autre que le français pour ce poste. Cependant, la maîtrise de l'anglais est essentielle pour ce poste, car l'employé devra communiquer régulièrement avec des collègues et des parties prenantes situés à l'extérieur du Québec, où l'anglais est la principale langue de communication entre les bureaux. Language Requirement Justification NetEase is committed to supporting a French-speaking workenvironment for its employees in Quebec. Every effort has been made to avoidrequiring a language other than French for this position. However, proficiency in English is essential for thisrole because the employee will be required to communicate regularly with colleagues and stakeholders located outside Quebec, where English is theprimary language of communication between offices.

jobs.description:
LOS ANGELES COMMUNITY COLLEGE DISTRICT

**P****ROFESSIONAL** **O****PPORTUNITIES**

**Adjunct - AY27 Multimedia Instructor, Game and Art Design**

**Temporary Assignment - Pool Announcement**

**APPLICATION CLOSING DATE:** **Open Until Filled**

The Los Angeles Community College District (LACCD) is the largest community college district in the United States and one of the largest in the world. The LACCD is comprised of nine colleges serving all or part of more than 40 cities in Southern California and spanning a service area of 882 square miles. Its colleges offer instruction to 225,000 students, annually, in 600 associates’ degree and 400 certificate of achievement programs in general, career-technical and transfer education, and contribute significantly to the economic and social well-being of its students, the regional economy and the greater Los Angeles area. For more information about the LACCD, please visit our website at www.laccd.edu.

**POSITION**
============

The instructor will teach a mix of courses in the Multimedia Game Art & Design and Animation disciplines. Department responsibilities include participating in eSports lab, Student Learning Outcome Committee. This is an adjunct, hourly, academic position that may include teaching day, evening, weekend, hybrid, online, in-person, and/or dual enrollment classes. Duties beyond the classroom include office hours. Excellent collaboration, organization and communication skills required.

  

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Teach classes assigned by the Chair on campus (in-person classes), hybrid, online, or at dual enrollment sites.

* Teach beginning, intermediate, and advanced courses in game art & design, animation, virtual production, visual development, and production courses.

* Create an engaging and inclusive learning environment.

* Remain current in the discipline, teaching methods, and instructional technology

* Supervise student projects in a production environment.

* Possible participation in outreach to high schools, open houses (include summer bootcamp), and dual enrollment activities.

* Advise and mentor game art & design, and animation majors on pathways to careers, certificates, degrees, and transfers processes to promote student success.

* Assess student performance and maintain accurate student records (rosters and grades), and other administrative requirements.

* Use a variety of teaching tools, including software, video, and audio technology, including specialty software in animation and game art design.

* Assignments may be day, evening, or weekends, and may be on the campus, online, or at a Dual Enrollment site. Opportunities exist for summer and winter intersession teaching.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:**

* **Bachelor’s** degree and two years of professional experience **OR**;
* **Associate’s** degree and six years of professional experience.
* A sensitivity to and an understanding of the diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, disability, and ethnic backgrounds of community college students.

**NOTE:** Professional experience must be directly related to the teaching assignment.

  

**HEALTH:**

A medical certificate indicating fitness to instruct or associate with students is required at the applicant's expense after selection from an eligible list and prior to employment.

**ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENT**

Pursuant to LACCD Board of Trustee's Policy 2900 all employees must be fully vaccinated or have an approved exemption. LACCD employees are required to provide their vaccination status in compliance with the LACCD Board of Trustees’ policy. Newly hired employees **will be** required to provide their vaccination status prior to starting a position or, at the latest, by their position start date.

**DESIRABLE QUALIFICATIONS (any from below):**

* Professional work experience in game production, pre-visualization or virtual production with an emphasis on game level design and game prototyping with Unreal Engine or similar game engine.

* Expertise in a wide range game art & design and animation software.

* Experience working with 3D modeling applications such as Autodesk Maya, Blender and Zbrush.

* Experience teaching students or leading a team in a content production environment.

* College level teaching experience specialty courses in game art & design or animation.

* Teaching underprepared students in a community college.

* Teaching a diverse student population.

* MFA in animation or game art & design.

* Possess strong oral, written, and visual communication skills.

* Networks in local, regional, or national professional or educational organizations.

* Ability to establish partnerships game or animation companies to build internship or apprenticeship pathways for students.

* Evidence of learner-centered teaching and ability to inspire, motivate and empower students to succeed.

* Experience with a variety of teaching strategies to accommodate diverse learning styles.

**COMPENSATION**
================

The salary schedule for adjunct instructors begins at **$89.72** per standard hour, plus an office hour differential of **$20.99** per hour for classroom assignments. Applicants with a doctoral degree are eligible for a doctoral differential.

jobs.description:
**TITLE:** Padres Production -Audio Technician

**DEPARTMENT:** Scoreboard Operations

**REPORTS TO:** Director, Scoreboard Operations

**STATUS:** Part-Time; Non-Exempt

  

**San Diego Padres Commitment**:

  

The San Diego Padres are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment for our employees. We strive to create an environment for everyone by including perspectives from backgrounds that vary by race, ethnicity, religion, gender, age, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status, and national origin.

  

*If you are not sure you’re 100% qualified but are up for the challenge – we want you to apply. We believe* *skills are transferable and passion for our mission goes a long way.*

  

**San Diego Padres Petco Park Promise:**

Our service values drive our behaviors to create the best experience for all our guests who visit Petco Park. As a team member at Petco Park, we genuinely and passionately care about our guests, our ballpark, and each other. We make meaningful and memorable connections that set us apart from other venues and experiences. Each position on our team actively lives out this nonnegotiable commitment every day to CARE, CONNECT, EXCEED.

  

**Your role as an Audio Technician:**

You will be primarily responsible for ensuring high-quality audio production for Padres games, concerts, and other special events held at Petco Park, including Gallagher Square.

  

**All the responsibilities we will trust you with:**

* Exemplifying our Petco Park Promise: CARE, CONNECT, EXCEED by proactively welcoming all guests to the ballpark and consistently striving to exceed all guests' expectations
* Operating various audio mixing boards, microphones, speakers, and other audio equipment during Padres games, concerts, and special events
* Setting up and operating audio systems throughout the ballpark, including Gallagher Square, while working independently or as part of a team
* Setting up microphones, stage wedges, stage snakes, subwoofers, front fills, monitors, FOH processors, and related equipment for concerts, live entertainment, and special events
* Performing line and sound checks, including those for national anthems and other musical performances, to ensure equipment is functioning properly
* Operating control consoles to monitor and adjust audio levels, ensuring the correct audio feeds and appropriate volume levels throughout the ballpark
* Assisting the Audio Engineer with power distribution, cable runs, audio signal routing, and stage and FOH cable management
* Collaborating with Padres Front Office employees, technical staff, touring production teams, vendors, and special guests to meet event-specific audio needs while maintaining a calm and professional demeanor
* Troubleshooting and maintaining audio equipment and keeping detailed equipment inventories
* Working with Ballpark Management to coordinate local audio systems with the house audio system for various events
* Supporting control room operations for Padres games and in-stadium entertainment, including working with the A1 and DJs to deliver the best possible sound experience for fans
* Keeping up with the team's performance on the field, current organizational news, and demonstrating general baseball and Padres history knowledge
* Performing a variety of duties, including rotation based on departmental needs, and assuming other responsibilities as assigned by the Vice President of Broadcasting & Presentation, Director of Scoreboard Operations, Director of Event Production & Video Engineering, Manager of Engineering, and Audio Engineer

  

**Your areas of knowledge and expertise that matter most:**

* Being consistent, punctual, and having reliable attendance
* Having strong knowledge of audio system signal flow and the operation of microphones, speakers, amplifiers, and digital/analog audio mixers
* Understanding microphone and line-level input signal flow and having basic knowledge of distributed audio systems
* Having excellent communication skills and a positive, energetic personality
* Possessing proficient computer skills with the ability to multitask, react quickly to live event and game action, and maintain attention to detail
* Possessing a high degree of discretion, integrity, and accountability
* Working collaboratively and respectfully with others in a fast-paced, high-pressure, team-oriented environment
* Having strong knowledge of baseball and the Padres organization

  

**Additional knowledge and experience we'd love for you to bring (preferred, but not required):**

* Relevant experience supporting audio operations for concerts, live entertainment, festivals, large-scale special events, television production, scoreboard operations, or comparable production/control room environments.
* Experience operating or serving as a system engineer for L-Acoustics audio systems, particularly the L-Acoustics L2 PA system in Gallagher Square

* Familiarity with digital audio mixing consoles, including Allen & Heath dLive C1500, DiGiCo Quantum 225, and Allen & Heath SQ5
* Experience with concert audio equipment, stage and FOH power distribution, cable management, and audio signal routing, including AVB and Dante protocols
* Experience collaborating with touring production teams, audio engineers, and other live entertainment professionals
* Bachelor's degree in audio production, entertainment technology, or a related field
* Being bilingual in English and Spanish

jobs.description: About the Team OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. The Global Events Studio Team creates exceptional live and recorded video for Press, Marketing, Developer Experience, and Communications. About the Role The Audio Engineer will be the senior audio authority for high-profile livestreams, broadcast-style productions, studio recordings, public venue events, and critical on-location shoots. This person will design resilient audio systems, serve as A1 when failures are immediately visible, and deliver exceptional spoken-word audio across live, recorded, remote, and AI-enabled production workflows. In this role, you will: Own audio design and A1 execution for complex broadcasts, live stage events, podcasts, and critical film/on-location shoots Build and operate redundant program, stream, multitrack, camera, backup-recorder, and archival audio paths with real-time monitoring and recovery procedures. Mix full-duplex speech-to-speech audio between humans and AI models Design, commission, standardize, document, and improve audio signal flow for studios, control rooms, event spaces, and portable production systems. Rapidly assess unfamiliar venues and design reliable systems around acoustic, power, network, access, RF, and footprint constraints. Lead rigorous preproduction: technical designs, input lists, patch plans, frequency plans, rehearsals, testing, monitoring, redundancy, and fallback capture. Diagnose and repair signal-chain, DSP, synchronization, routing, RF, networking, and hardware faults during live production. Lead audio crews and freelancers, challenge flawed technical plans, and communicate decisive options under pressure. Own multitrack recording, editorial handoff, backup, delivery, and archival workflows across professional formats and specifications. You might thrive in this role if you have: 8+ years engineering complex live, broadcast, and studio production, including high-profile livestreams, public venue events, design, configuration, and programming of physical audio infrastructure, and critical on-location filming or streaming. Deep experience designing and troubleshooting redundant program, stream, multitrack, camera, backup-recorder, and archival audio paths. Advanced proficiency with networked audio and DSP systems such as Dante, AVB, SMPTE ST 2110, Q-SYS, Yamaha, and Shure. Strong IP-networking knowledge, including clocking, multicast, VLANs, QoS, and diagnosing failures across audio, control, and enterprise IT environments. Expert wireless-microphone and RF coordination skills across crowded, high-consequence production environments, including frequency planning, antenna distribution, and intermodulation. Strong multitrack recording, timecode, sync, metadata, editing, mixing, delivery, backup, and archival judgment across professional formats and loudness specifications. Functional audio post-production skills, including dialogue cleanup, noise reduction, EQ, dynamics, mix revisions, and delivery preparation. Ability to lead audio crews, support technical freelancers, challenge flawed technical plans, and communicate decisive options under pressure. Willingness to work onsite, travel globally as needed, and support rehearsals or productions outside standard hours when critical productions require it. Diverse thoughts, experiences, and individual characteristics enrich our work environment and lead to better business decisions. jobs.title: Sound Designer – Unpublished R&D Product (Contract)
jobs.description: 岗位定位 我们希望找到一位对游戏、玩家体验和声音设计充满热情的游戏音频设计师。 你将与游戏设计、美术、叙事、动画、工程等团队紧密合作 。 这不仅是一个“制作声音资产”的岗位。你需要理解 为什么需要这个声音、玩家什么时候听到它，以及它如何服务于玩法和体验。 主要职责 负责游戏中 音效的设计、制作与实现。 根据玩法目标和玩家体验，建立清晰、有辨识度且具有情绪表现力的声音语言。 参与游戏音乐设计 。 使用 Wwise / FMOD / Unreal / Unity 或内部引擎 完成音频资产的游戏内实现。 设计音乐与音效的 state 、Transition、Layer、Trigger及其他交互逻辑。 与 Game Design、Art、Narrative、Animation、Engineering 等团队合作，将抽象体验目标转化为可执行的音频方案。 在保证艺术品质的同时，关注 玩法信息传达、声音层级、可读性以及游戏性能 。 主动根据玩家反馈、测试结果和团队反馈持续迭代。 与外部作曲家、录音师、音频供应商等合作，并能够提供明确、有效的创作反馈。 任职要求 具备成熟的 游戏音效设计与制作能力 ，能够独立完成从概念到游戏内落地的完整流程。 熟练使用主流 DAW 及声音设计工具，如 Pro Tools、Reaper、Nuendo、Ableton、iZotope 等。 熟悉 Wwise / FMOD 等音频中间件，并具备实际游戏项目实施经验。 理解游戏引擎中的音频工作方式，具备 Unreal、Unity 或其他商业/自研引擎经验。 对 Gameplay Feedback、声音层级、空间音频和交互式音频系统 有深入理解。 能够理解产品和设计目标，而不是仅从单一声音资产的品质出发进行设计。 具备良好的跨职能沟通能力，能够清晰表达设计意图，并处理来自不同专业方向的反馈和分歧。 我们尤其看重 能够从 玩家体验 而不是单纯从音频专业角度判断方案。 能够解释自己的设计决策，而不仅仅依赖个人审美。 面对设计、工程或制作限制时，能够找到体验、品质和成本之间的合理平衡。 能够主动发现体验问题，并推动相关团队一起解决。 对反馈开放，同时拥有明确的专业判断和设计立场。 加分项 参与过完整上线的 PC / Console / Mobile 游戏项目。 熟悉交互式音乐设计及实时音乐系统。 具有作曲、编曲或乐器演奏能力。 具有 Voice Over 制作、录音及后期经验。 具备基础 Blueprint / Lua / Python 或其他脚本能力。 有大型全球化团队或跨地区协作经验。 作品集要求 作品集建议包含： 游戏内实际音效设计案例 Gameplay Feedback 音频案例 环境及空间声音设计 交互式音乐或音乐系统案例 Wwise / FMOD / 游戏引擎内实现案例 我们尤其希望看到的不只是最终 Demo，而是： 设计目标 → 音频思路 → 游戏内实现 → 最终玩家体验 并请明确说明每个案例中 你本人负责的具体部分 。 用工性质：与专业人事服务公司FESCO Adecco签订劳动合同 #LI-DNP

                                                                                            EA SPORTS is one of the most iconic brands in entertainment – connecting hundreds of millions worldwide to the sports they love through a portfolio of industry-leading video games.Building on an incredible 30-year foundation, we’re redefining football with EA SPORTS FC - a genre-leading ecosystem of interactive experiences, bringing a global community of football fans closer to The World's Game. Together, we’re taking the largest football club in the world to new heights – and this is just the beginning! With more opportunities than ever to innovate and create new, authentic experiences that bring joy, inclusivity, and immersion to fans everywhere, we invite you to join us as we pioneer the future of football with EA SPORTS FC and welcome everyone to the club!FC Audio team is looking for an experienced Audio Artist who can immediately contribute to audio development. You will oversee the audio-specific project(s) to create/maintain a quality audio experience. You are expected to have experience in all audio design and production phases, with proficiency in at least one audio discipline/area. audio hardwareExperience with tracking documentationOutstanding sound design skillsWorks well as part of a team but also autonomouslyExperience with audio middleware software (Wwise, Fmod)Familiarity recording techniques, with a high level of proficiency in at least one DAWAble to methodically manage & track large amounts of data Bonus SkillsExperience with Quality Assurance VerificationExperience with onboarding new team membersKnowledge and familiarity with Professional sports (mainly Football/Soccer), teams, leaguesProficiency with VBA macros, SQL, Python, JavaScript, etc.Experience with remote VO recording sessions
                                                                                    
                                    
                                                                                                                                
                                        
                                        
                                                                                            Pay Transparency - North America
                                                                                    
                                    
                                                                                                                                
                                        
                                        
                                                                                            COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS The ranges listed below are what EA in good faith expects to pay applicants for this role in these locations at the time of this posting. If you reside in a different location, a recruiter will advise on the applicable range and benefits. Pay offered will be determined based on a number of relevant business and candidate factors (e.g. education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, or business needs). PAY RANGES
                                                                                    
                                    
                                                                                                                                
                                        
                                        
                                                                                            * British Columbia (depending on location e.g. Vancouver vs. Victoria) *$67,000 - $92,700 CAD
                                                                                    
                                    
                                                                                                                                
                                        
                                        
                                                                                            Pay is just one part of the overall compensation at EA.
                                                                                    
                                    
                                                                                                                                
                                        
                                        
                                                                                             In Canada, we offer a package of benefits including vacation (3 weeks per year to start), 10 days per year of sick time, and extended health/dental/vision coverage and basic life insurance.
                                                                                    
                                    
                                                                                                                                
                                        
                                        
                                                                                            About Electronic ArtsWe’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.Electronic Arts is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will also consider employment qualified applicants with criminal records in accordance with applicable law.
